text_block_list.text:
The Kinko Sho had been set as the goal for 
her first race in the Senior tier. Though 
it was a GII race, 
an incredible roster of competitors had 
gathered today.
choice_data_list: Even so, all eyes are on you.
Even so, you're the main attraction.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes.

Not only was she a Triple Tiara horsegirl, 
but her run 
in the Japan Cup had earned her the 
reputation of being 
powerful regardless of the racing 
division.
choice_data_list:
Just checking, but you're not feeling 
pressured, are you?

Just checking, but are you feeling any 
pressure?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Of course not.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Rather, I'm looking forward to it. 
Today, I believe I can purely... 
test the true extent of my current 
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Witnessing Almond Eye's strength made 
me 
realize that there is always greater 
heights above.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And I intend to run with all my might 
to reach those heights!

Daring Tact's eyes sparkled with fierce 
determination. 
She was in peak condition, both in body 
and mind—
choice_data_list:
Alright, go out there and give it 
everything you've got!

Alright, give it your absolute all out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! 
We meet again on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki. 
It's an honor to run with you today.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oho! To carry yourself with such calm 
composure before a race... 
You truly are no ordinary girl!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, but I already knew that. 
Your run in the Japan Cup is burned into 
my mind. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've been battling that incredible 
protagonist 
this whole, entire time!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know you've got strong feelings toward 
Almond Eye, 
but mine go more than double that! I 
guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—The next chapter of the Twinkle Series 
is gonna be the Kiseki Arc!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Would a 'Daring Tact Arc' 
not be quite as interesting to you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A new Triple Tiara horsegirl surpassing 
the legendary 
Triple Tiara champion—how does a plot like 
that sound?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Guh! Sounds thrilling, sure, but... 
Still, I'm not giving this up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I believe surpassing Almond Eye 
is my duty now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Which is why today— 
I will demonstrate that resolve to 
everyone!
